experiment_data.hypothesis: TCN σ=0.2 cross-environment validation on Cheetah Run: tests whether CIVO suppression generalizes beyond Walker Walk. Cheetah exhibits stronger CIVO (NVE 8.27-70.64× in exp_010b) so this is a harder test. Same CIVO-inducing config (gate_fixed_dt=2, subsample_max_dt=2, imag_horizon=8) + TCN σ=0.2. If NVE<1.5× and eval maintained → TCN is environment-agnostic intervention.

spec.command: source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/autodl-tmp/event-gated-adaptive-horizon && LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libstdc++.so.6 MUJOCO_GL=egl MUJOCO_EGL_DEVICE_ID=0 python -u dreamer.py --configs defaults dmc_proprio --task dmc_cheetah_run --steps 210000 --seed 0 --device cuda:0 --compile False --gate_enabled True --gate_fixed_dt 2 --gate_subsample_max_dt 2 --imag_horizon 8 --tcn_enabled True --tcn_sigma 0.2 --logdir logdir/exp_030a_tcn_cheetah_s0_sigma02
